description: NL2SQL gold set over the Task-3 SQLite analytics schema. Each item has a question and a reference (gold) SQL. Evaluation = Execution Accuracy: run predicted vs gold SQL and compare result sets (order-insensitive).

samples.question: 每个科室的就诊量是多少
samples.sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits GROUP BY department

samples.question: 高血压患者的平均年龄是多少
samples.sql: SELECT AVG(age) FROM patient_visits WHERE disease='高血压'

samples.question: 各疾病的就诊人次有多少
samples.sql: SELECT disease, COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits GROUP BY disease

samples.question: 2024年每个月的就诊量分别是多少
samples.sql: SELECT substr(visit_date,1,7) AS m, COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits GROUP BY m

samples.question: 开具次数最多的5种药物是哪些
samples.sql: SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS c FROM prescriptions GROUP BY drug ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5

samples.question: 男性和女性的就诊人次各是多少
samples.sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits GROUP BY gender

samples.question: 内科的平均就诊费用是多少
samples.sql: SELECT AVG(cost) FROM patient_visits WHERE department='内科'

samples.question: 60岁以上的患者有多少次就诊
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits WHERE age>60

samples.question: 每个科室的平均就诊费用是多少
samples.sql: SELECT department, AVG(cost) FROM patient_visits GROUP BY department

samples.question: 阿司匹林肠溶片一共被开具了多少次
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prescriptions WHERE drug='阿司匹林肠溶片'

samples.question: 每种疾病患者的平均年龄是多少
samples.sql: SELECT disease, AVG(age) FROM patient_visits GROUP BY disease

samples.question: 所有就诊的总费用是多少
女性高血压患者有多少次就诊

samples.question: 每个检查项目的异常次数是多少
samples.sql: SELECT test_name, SUM(abnormal) FROM lab_tests GROUP BY test_name

samples.question: 就诊量最高的3个科室
samples.sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS c FROM patient_visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 3
